notes_for_editor: The only source for this tower is one row of the tnlandforms GA list (GA205, coordinates, elevation, GFC 323, BLL-41111). No NHLR, FFLOS, Vanishing Georgia or Wikimedia Commons page in our caches names it. Two web searches turned up the Ellaville courthouse clock tower and the town's history, not a lookout; the Schley County courthouse is not a fire tower and is not used. A 1957 Georgia Forestry magazine page in the cache has a photo caption that mentions Ellaville (about arson), with no tower named; it is unchecked and not used. The list's naming note applies because GA205 is above 73, so 'Ellaville' is a label. The list gives elevations with no unit on the page, so the story now gives 581 with no unit. The tower record (data/towers/ga/us-ga-ellaville.json) reads it as feet and has elevation_m 177.1; that conversion is not in any source and needs the editor's decision. Status, build date, design, staffing and access are all unknown. Story is about 140 words. Verification 2026-10-21: one unsourced unit fixed; one near-verbatim phrase reworded; all 4 quotes found on the first check.
